name: A Time for Us
overview: It follows Angela, a Malaysian woman who unearths a clue to her father’s mysterious disappearance – one that takes her into a shadowy world of international corruption. Meanwhile, Miguel, a Filipino Interpol agent, is on a parallel mission to dismantle a Southeast Asian crime syndicate – and unknowingly to confront the truth behind his own father’s unsolved murder. When Miguel and Angela’s investigations converge, they discover their families are deeply intertwined in a cover-up that spans decades.
